chapter: Woody Herman, Henderson and the Indiana Theater
title: Leaving Woody Herman and passing on a chance to join Duke
summary: He was with Herman about two years, and told Ellington he could not play trumpet after so long.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: How many years were you with Woody, or how long were you with Woody?
From -- let me see, '38, '39, '40, '41. Round about -- I guess I'd maybe say -- just put it right together -- no, no, I believe I was with him about two years, I believe.
Uh-huh. Were you still playing trumpet at this time? Or just arranging?
Just arranging, because when I left Woody's band, I had a chance to go with Duke if I could play trumpet, but I hadn't played trumpet in a long time.
And I didn't even try. I told Duke, I haven't laid a trumpet to my mouth in I don't know when.
